title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (signal.schema.json)
description: patch_file returned error: 'old_string not found in src/moeb/internal/signal.schema.json'. The intended change was recovered by write_file fallback so the operation completed, but the patch_file failure was recorded as a tool error. Likely caused by CRLF line endings in the file not matching the LF string supplied to patch_file.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file fails with old_string not found despite content appearing to match when read. The CRLF normalization in patch_file.rs may not cover all cases on Windows. Confirm the normalization applies to both the file content and the old_string before substring matching.
